sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我是珍娜·费舍尔。

sentences.en: And I'm Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 我是安吉拉·金赛。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们还是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专门为你制作了这档《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: We're The Office ladies.
sentences.zh: 我们是《办公室》女士。

sentences.en: Ho!
sentences.zh: 吼！

sentences.en: Ho, ho, ho.
sentences.zh: 吼，吼，吼。

sentences.en: Are you ready for some Christmas wishes?
sentences.zh: 准备好迎接圣诞愿望了吗？

sentences.en: Boy, am I.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我准备好了。

sentences.en: This is Season 8, Episode 10.
sentences.zh: 这是第八季第十集。

sentences.en: It was written by Mindy Kaling.
sentences.zh: 由敏迪·卡灵编剧。

sentences.en: This was her third Christmas episode, Angela.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，这是她写的第三集圣诞特辑了。

sentences.en: I did not realize she was the go-to Christmas writer until we started this rewatch.
sentences.zh: 直到开始重温这部剧，我才意识到她是御用的圣诞编剧。

sentences.en: Apparently so.
sentences.zh: 看来确实如此。

sentences.en: She also wrote Diwali.
sentences.zh: 她还写过《排灯节》那一集。

sentences.en: She's like our, I guess, if it's a holiday, give it to Mindy.
sentences.zh: 她就像我们的……我想，只要是节日，就交给敏迪写吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This episode was also directed by Ed HelMs.
sentences.zh: 这一集还是由艾德·赫尔姆斯执导的。

sentences.en: This was his directorial debut.
sentences.zh: 这是他的导演处女作。

sentences.en: So I would do this thing when we had a cast member who directed for the first time.
sentences.zh: 所以每当有剧组成员第一次担任导演时，我都会做一件事。

sentences.en: I would get everyone to sign the script and give it to them as a gift.
sentences.zh: 我会让所有人都在剧本上签名，然后把它作为礼物送给他们。

sentences.en: Aw.
sentences.zh: 噢。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I gave it to Ed, and he was like, Ange, I love this.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我把它送给了艾德，他说，安吉，我太喜欢这个了。

sentences.en: Well, I was not in this episode.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我没参与这一集。

sentences.en: I was at home with my new baby, so I did not get to participate in any of the fun stuff that happened.
sentences.zh: 当时我正带着刚出生的宝宝在家，所以没能参与其中发生的任何趣事。

sentences.en: And oh my gosh, this episode has a lot.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这一集的内容可真丰富。

sentences.en: Here's your summary.
sentences.zh: 这是剧情梗概。

sentences.en: Determined to make this the best office Christmas party ever, Andy promises to make each employee's holiday wish come true.
sentences.zh: 安迪决心举办一场史上最棒的办公室圣诞派对，他承诺要实现每位员工的节日愿望。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Dwight and Jim are pranking one another, and someone has complained.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，德怀特和吉姆在互相恶作剧，有人对此提出了投诉。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Someone in their desk clump.
sentences.zh: 就是他们办公桌区域里的某个人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Andy gives them an ultimatum.
sentences.zh: 安迪给他们下了最后通牒。

sentences.en: Yes, he does.
sentences.zh: 是的，他确实这么做了。

sentences.en: He says, the two of you need to stop pranking each other, or I'm going to give your Christmas bonuses to the other person.
sentences.zh: 他说，你们两个必须停止互相恶作剧，否则我就把你们的圣诞奖金给对方。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Well, listen, everyone, we are going to kick off this episode of Office Ladies with an interview with the one and only Amina Kaplan.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，我们要用对独一无二的阿米娜·卡普兰的采访来开启本期《办公室》女士节目。

sentences.en: You know, she appeared as Val in 14 episodes of The Office, including Christmas Wishes.
sentences.zh: 你们知道，她在《办公室》的14集中饰演了瓦尔，包括《圣诞愿望》这一集。

sentences.en: Amina attended Tisch School of the Arts in New York, and she has won theater awards for choreography, and she can play the druMs.
sentences.zh: 阿米娜曾就读于纽约大学帝势艺术学院，她获得过戏剧编舞奖，而且还会打鼓。

sentences.en: Can she play the drums?
sentences.zh: 她会打鼓吗？

sentences.en: She's like a professional drummer and now a director.
sentences.zh: 她不仅是专业鼓手，现在还是一名导演。

sentences.en: We can't wait for you to hear this interview.
sentences.zh: 我们迫不及待想让你们听到这段采访了。

sentences.en: We love her.
sentences.zh: 我们很爱她。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So without further ado, here you go.
sentences.zh: 那么，废话不多说，请听采访。

sentences.en: Woo-hoo.
sentences.zh: 呜呼。

sentences.en: Hey, everybody.
sentences.zh: 嘿，大家好。

sentences.en: What's up?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: How y'all doing?
sentences.zh: 大家好吗？

sentences.en: Oh, we're good.
sentences.zh: 噢，我们很好。

sentences.en: So good to see you.
sentences.zh: 见到你们真高兴。

sentences.en: It's good to see you, too.
sentences.zh: 见到你我也很高兴。

sentences.en: It's been a while.
sentences.zh: 好久不见了。

sentences.en: It's been a hot minute, in fact.
sentences.zh: 事实上，确实有一阵子没见了。

sentences.en: It's been a long time.
sentences.zh: 确实是很久了。

sentences.en: It sure has.
sentences.zh: 确实是这样。

sentences.en: And we're Zooming with you today.
sentences.zh: 今天我们通过Zoom和你连线。

sentences.en: You're in New Orleans?
sentences.zh: 你在新奥尔良吗？

sentences.en: I am.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This is my first time in New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次来新奥尔良。

sentences.en: It's awesome down here.
sentences.zh: 这里太棒了。

sentences.en: It's been a special place to me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是一个很特别的地方。

sentences.en: I was born in Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 我出生在路易斯安那州。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I was born in Lafayette, and I did two movies in New Orleans, and my family would come and visit.
sentences.zh: 是的，我出生在拉斐特，我在新奥尔良拍过两部电影，我的家人也会来探班。

sentences.en: And so I'm going to email you a few spots that you've got to check out.
sentences.zh: 所以我待会儿发邮件给你，推荐几个你一定要去看看的地方。

sentences.en: I would love that, because I have the rest of my afternoon, like after 4 o'clock, I'm going to be free.
sentences.zh: 那太好了，因为我下午剩下的时间，大概4点以后，我就有空了。

sentences.en: So that's all I'm going to do is just go around to spots in New Orleans, because we're working hard here.
sentences.zh: 所以我打算就在新奥尔良到处转转，因为我们在这里工作很辛苦。

sentences.en: So we have this full schedule, although I took this hour out to hang out with you guys.
sentences.zh: 我们行程排得很满，不过我特意空出这一小时来和你们聊天。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Oh, we love that.
sentences.zh: 噢，我们太开心了。

sentences.en: It's my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Well, we'll jump right in then.
sentences.zh: 那我们就直接开始吧。

sentences.en: We're going to ask you the question that we ask every guest to kick things off, which is, how did you get your job on The Office?
sentences.zh: 我们要问你一个每个嘉宾都会被问到的开场问题：你是怎么得到《办公室》里那个角色的？

sentences.en: Aha.
sentences.zh: 啊哈。

sentences.en: Awesome casting director, Alison Jones, cast me.
sentences.zh: 是出色的选角导演艾莉森·琼斯选的我。

sentences.en: I was literally just an actor in L.A., just doing my thing.
sentences.zh: 当时我只是洛杉矶的一名普通演员，做着自己的事。

sentences.en: And it literally just came through as a regular audition.
sentences.zh: 那个机会就像普通的试镜一样找上门来。

sentences.en: There it was.
sentences.zh: 机会就这样出现了。

sentences.en: Just like, boom, there's a character on a TV show.
sentences.zh: 就像是，砰的一声，电视剧里有个角色。

sentences.en: You're right for it.
sentences.zh: 你很适合这个角色。

sentences.en: You're going to go in for that job.
sentences.zh: 你要去争取那份工作。

sentences.en: And it turned out to be serendipitous and special in that I was acquainted with Craig Robinson before I went into my audition.
sentences.zh: 结果证明这非常巧合且特别，因为在去试镜之前，我就认识克雷格·罗宾逊了。

sentences.en: I did not know he was going to be at the callback.
sentences.zh: 我当时不知道他会出现在复试现场。

sentences.en: I didn't actually see him.
sentences.zh: 其实我没看到他。

sentences.en: He saw me.
sentences.zh: 是他看到了我。

sentences.en: If you ask Craig, Craig would be like, you don't even know, like, how much I got you on that show.
sentences.zh: 如果你去问克雷格，他会说，你根本不知道我为你争取到那个角色出了多少力。

sentences.en: So I'm like, all right, Craig, whatever I owe it to you.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，好吧，克雷格，不管怎样我都欠你一个人情。

sentences.en: So I give him the credit.
sentences.zh: 所以我把功劳归给他。

sentences.en: Like, I think Craig really was like, oh, snap, that's Amina.
sentences.zh: 我觉得克雷格当时肯定是想，噢，天哪，那是阿米娜。

sentences.en: I know Amina.
sentences.zh: 我认识阿米娜。

sentences.en: And, you know, we're both musicians.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们都是音乐人。

sentences.en: And so we kind of knew each other from the music scene.
sentences.zh: 所以我们算是从音乐圈认识的。

sentences.en: Yeah, you play drums, right?
sentences.zh: 没错，你会打鼓，对吧？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm a drummer.
sentences.zh: 我是个鼓手。

sentences.en: I honestly feel like that's kind of the only real thing that I am.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我觉得这大概是我唯一真正擅长的事情。

sentences.en: I'm a hack with everything else.
sentences.zh: 除此之外我都是个半吊子。

sentences.en: Because looking back at it at this age, I'm like, yeah, drumming, that's the thing that I did when I was nine years old.
sentences.zh: 因为到了这个年纪回首往事，我会想，没错，打鼓，那是我九岁时就开始做的事。

sentences.en: I just was beating on stuff.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是在那儿乱敲一气。

sentences.en: I was like hitting things and making rhythms and making beats on desktops and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我会在桌面上敲敲打打，制造节奏，打出节拍之类的。

sentences.en: And when I was 12, a guy taught me how to play Bullet to Blue Sky by U2 on the drum set.
sentences.zh: 12岁那年，有个人教我在架子鼓上打U2乐队的《Bullet the Blue Sky》。

sentences.en: And I was like, OK.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，好吧。

sentences.en: And I was terrible for years and years and years because I had no training.
sentences.zh: 因为没受过专业训练，我烂了好多年好多年。

sentences.en: And my family was like, what do you think you're doing playing drums?
sentences.zh: 我家人当时就问，你以为你在打鼓是在干什么呢？

sentences.en: And I was like, I'm doing this.
sentences.zh: 我就说，我就是在做这个。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I'm a drummer and have been.
sentences.zh: 但没错，我是一名鼓手，一直都是。

sentences.en: This will be a long time.
sentences.zh: 这已经是很久以前的事了。

sentences.en: I'm like, this year will be 40 years of playing once I, like later this year.
sentences.zh: 我想，今年晚些时候，我就打鼓满40年了。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, it is the only thing that I really am.
sentences.zh: 所以，没错，这确实是我唯一真正称得上是身份的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Craig's a musician.
sentences.zh: 克雷格也是个音乐人。

sentences.en: And we were in a band full of actors.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在一个全是演员的乐队里。

sentences.en: So if anybody got a gig, nobody was worried.
sentences.zh: 所以如果谁接到了演出，大家也不会担心。

sentences.en: It was like, OK, whatever.
sentences.zh: 就像是，好吧，随便吧。

sentences.en: I booked the thing.
sentences.zh: 我接了个活儿。

sentences.en: OK, whatever.
sentences.zh: 好吧，随便吧。

sentences.en: And Craig was friends with the guys in the band.
sentences.zh: 克雷格和乐队里的那些人是朋友。

sentences.en: And they used to hang out.
sentences.zh: 他们以前经常一起玩。

sentences.en: And being the girl in the band, I never really hung out with them.
sentences.zh: 作为乐队里唯一的女生，我其实从来没怎么跟他们混在一起。

sentences.en: But we were around the same scene.
sentences.zh: 但我们都在同一个圈子里。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Oh, in my heart right now, if there ever is an office reunion,
sentences.zh: 噢，在我心里，如果《办公室》真的要重聚的话，

sentences.en: Val's got to play the druMs.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔必须得打鼓。

sentences.en: Val's got to boot Kevin out of the band.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔得把凯文踢出乐队。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Was it killing you when you had to sit and listen to them play?
sentences.zh: 当你不得不坐在那儿听他们演奏时，是不是很难受？

sentences.en: And you're like, I could be the drummer in Kevin in the Zits.
sentences.zh: 你当时是不是在想，我本可以成为“凯文和青春痘”乐队的鼓手。

sentences.en: I'm not even going to mince words.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都不想委婉地说。

sentences.en: The answer is yes.
sentences.zh: 答案是肯定的。

sentences.en: I was standing there.
sentences.zh: 我当时就站在那儿。

sentences.en: And I was like, you've got to be kidding me right now.
sentences.zh: 我心想，你们现在一定是在跟我开玩笑吧。

sentences.en: They are playing drums like two feet in front of me.
sentences.zh: 他们就在我面前两英尺的地方打鼓。

sentences.en: This is crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Like, why am I standing here?
sentences.zh: 就像是，我为什么站在这儿？

sentences.en: And why is Val not on the drums?
sentences.zh: 为什么瓦尔不在打鼓？

sentences.en: Why is she not the secret killer?
sentences.zh: 为什么她不是那个隐藏的高手？

sentences.en: And, you know, it's just one of those things.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这就是那种情况之一。

sentences.en: I was the new kid.
sentences.zh: 我是个新人。

sentences.en: It was Brian's moment.
sentences.zh: 那是布莱恩的高光时刻。

sentences.en: And it was awesome.
sentences.zh: 那真的很棒。

sentences.en: We had the drummers at the wrong band.
sentences.zh: 我们当时把鼓手放错乐队了。

sentences.en: It was just heaven.
sentences.zh: 那简直是天堂。

sentences.en: That day was that episode was just heaven for me.
sentences.zh: 那一天，那一集对我来说简直就是天堂。

sentences.en: And totally frustrating that I didn't speak up about being a drummer.
sentences.zh: 而且没能说出自己是鼓手这件事，也确实让人非常沮丧。

sentences.en: I kind of kept those worlds separate.
sentences.zh: 我当时算是把这两个世界分开了。

sentences.en: Because when I got to L.A., it was weird.
sentences.zh: 因为我刚到洛杉矶的时候，感觉很奇怪。

sentences.en: Like, coming from New York, where you could be a triple threat, as they called it or whatever.
sentences.zh: 就像从纽约过来，在那儿你可以是所谓的“三栖艺人”之类的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Coming to L.A., it was like, well, what are you?
sentences.zh: 到了洛杉矶，人们会问，你到底是干什么的？

sentences.en: Are you an actor?
sentences.zh: 你是演员吗？

sentences.en: Are you a drummer?
sentences.zh: 你是鼓手吗？

sentences.en: Are you a dancer?
sentences.zh: 你是舞者吗？

sentences.en: So, I never told anybody that I did the other thing.
sentences.zh: 所以我从不告诉别人我还会做别的事。

sentences.en: I did the other thing to keep from waiting tables, you know?
sentences.zh: 我做那些事只是为了不用去端盘子，你懂吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And so, but I never told anybody that I played druMs.
sentences.zh: 所以我从没告诉过任何人我会打鼓。

sentences.en: If you knew I was a drummer, you knew.
sentences.zh: 如果你知道我是鼓手，那你就知道了。

sentences.en: So, I didn't come into my acting auditions like, I'm a drummer.
sentences.zh: 所以，我去参加表演试镜时，不会表现得像个鼓手。

sentences.en: You know, I'm trying to book a job as like a young mom or something.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我当时想争取的是年轻妈妈之类的角色。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, I didn't come waving my rock and roll flag, so.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有挥舞着摇滚乐的大旗到处招摇。

sentences.en: It is so interesting because during that time, we were all auditioning around the same time back then.
sentences.zh: 这太有意思了，因为在那段时期，我们大家差不多都是同时期在试镜的。

sentences.en: And it really was kind of like, stay in your lane.
sentences.zh: 当时确实有一种“各司其职”的氛围。

sentences.en: You know, you're an actor.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你就是个演员。

sentences.en: But I feel like now people really share.
sentences.zh: 但我感觉现在大家真的很乐于分享。

sentences.en: I think social media has helped that, that you can share all the things you do.
sentences.zh: 我觉得社交媒体对此很有帮助，你可以分享你所做的一切。

sentences.en: And people learn, oh, you're this, this, and this.
sentences.zh: 人们会了解到，哦，原来你既是这个，又是那个，还是那个。

sentences.en: And that's great.
sentences.zh: 这很棒。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to say we did that.
sentences.zh: 我要说其实是我们开了先河。

sentences.en: We pioneered that because I was doing it before social media.
sentences.zh: 是我们引领了这种风气，因为我在社交媒体出现之前就在这么做了。

sentences.en: I'm from the 90s.
sentences.zh: 我是90年代的人。

sentences.en: Everybody on this podcast, we're from the 90s.
sentences.zh: 这个播客里的每个人，我们都是90年代的人。

sentences.en: Let's get our credit, Gen X.
sentences.zh: 我们要为自己正名，X世代。

sentences.en: Let's get our credit.
sentences.zh: 我们要争取属于我们的认可。

sentences.en: Because we were doing it in the cut.

sentences.zh: 所以你需要去看医生，或者带你的狗去兽医那里拔刺，
